notes.title: Bug fix + new content
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

So we've updated Hyper Color Ball.
Below is the list of fixes and changes.

List of changes:
[list]
    [*] - Bug fix - Issues with some players where certain aspects of the game don't show up or animate properly.
    [*] - New - A new sensitivity option.
    [*] - New - Music importer. Add your own beats while playing!
[/list]


Thanks,
Dan.
ːSuperPugː
